requirements.statement: A user can sign in through single sign-on to get a private, secure account

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is redirected to the sign-in page when opening the app
After signing in, the user lands on their own todo list
A signed-in user cannot see another user's todo items

requirements.statement: A user can add a todo item with a title and an optional due date

criteria.must: Submitting a new todo item with only a title succeeds
Submitting a new todo item with a title and a due date saves both fields
A newly added todo item appears in the user's todo list

requirements.statement: A user can see the list of their todo items, both outstanding and done

criteria.must: The todo list shows every todo item belonging to the signed-in user
Each listed todo item shows its title, due date (if any), and done/not-done status
The todo list persists across sign-out and sign-in, and across devices

requirements.statement: A user can mark a todo item as done or not done

criteria.must: Marking an outstanding todo item as done updates its status
Marking a done todo item as not done reverts its status

requirements.statement: A user can edit a todo item's title or due date

criteria.must: Changing a todo item's title saves the new title
Changing a todo item's due date saves the new due date

requirements.statement: A user can delete a todo item

criteria.must: Deleting a todo item removes it from the user's todo list
A deleted todo item does not reappear after refreshing or signing in again
